releaseNotes:
- Added native Linux `x64` and `arm64` Core release targets so AgentOS can be
  installed from the same signed release stream on macOS and Linux
- Added persistent install-level environment files through `--env-file`, with
  validation and reuse across installation, service startup, health checks,
  upgrades, and managed restarts
- Added `AGENTOS_HOME`, `AGENTOS_HOST`, `AGENTOS_PORT`, and
  `AGENTOS_MANAGE_LOCAL_SANDBOX` as the supported deployment settings, including
  Core-only Linux installations that use Cube instead of a local sandbox
- Added the active environment-file path to System settings without exposing
  its stored configuration values
- Extended offline and custom-prefix installation coverage so a Linux ARM64
  server can install Core under `/app` without creating its data directory in
  the account home

### Verification

- Passed the complete 274-test TypeScript, Server, UI, and TypeScript SDK suite
  after a production build
- Passed all 10 Java 8 SDK tests and built the `2.0.0-beta.14` SDK JAR
- Passed the Sandbox VMM Go test suite on macOS
- Passed focused bootstrap-installer, archive-retention, environment-file,
  Supervisor, and System-settings regression coverage
